0001102013331121301222230323 - ASI: 24

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  03 = 0 * 3
  11 = 1 * 1
  13 = 1 * 3
  22 = 2 * 2
  23 = 2 * 3
  33 = 3 * 3
  000 = 0 * 00
  213 = 2 * 13
  223 = 2 * 23
  333 = 3 * 33
  0122 = 01 * 22
  0323 = 03 * 23
  1102 = 11 * 02
  01333 = 01 * 333
  0001102 = 000 * 1102
  0133311 = 01333 * 11
  2130122 = 213 * 0122
  2230323 = 223 * 0323
  00011020133311 = 0001102 * 0133311
  21301222230323 = 2130122 * 2230323
  0001102013331121301222230323 = 00011020133311 * 21301222230323
